methodology: Editorial cross-studio selection of official movie-promotion videos, chosen for recognizable release campaigns, multiple visual idioms and evidence of substantial YouTube playback. Exact video IDs and public view-count sources were checked November 10, 2026; numbers are indexed or third-party observations, not live YouTube Analytics, not unique viewers, not a comparable opening-week metric, and not evidence of retention, sales or cinematic quality. Suggested techniques are research questions, not frame-verified findings. Five Disney-hosted trailers have partial browser-viewing notes and separately committed, source-hashed numeric measurements for 15 selected 20-second windows (research/movie-promo-measurements-2026-11-10.json). The reference media was temporarily downloaded for analysis, then removed, and was never added to Git or redistributed. Catalog review statuses remain editorial candidates until human-verified, full-runtime review.
